args.message: #1 Done: March IT recharge 40,000.00 USD booked on both sides (JE-1000-001231 Dr 1300 / Cr 4900 partner 2000; JE-2000-000692 Dr 6900 / Cr 2300 partner 1000, ref ICR-0326). Auto-mirror is off for 1000->2000, so both were entered manually. #5 Not posted manually: REC-RENT-1000 (14,900.25, Dr 6100 / Cr 2400) is an active recurring template due today and will post at tonight's 20:00 period-end run (JOB-0103). A manual entry would duplicate it.

#2 NS-50038: already paid. PAY-2026-04344 (23,240.00) was sent as a manual wire on 3/30 and the bank accepted it on 3/31 (BF-20260331-02, ACCP, value date 3/31). It is not on the statement yet because the statement runs through 3/30. Did not pay again. #4 BP-33483: paid today by same-day wire PAY-2026-04353 (12,620.00, released). #9 AUD-ACCR-0326: Priya's 08:12 attempt did not post. I posted it now as JE-1000-001232 (Dr 6400 / Cr 2400, 15,100.50). Nothing from the earlier attempt exists to reverse.
#3 KE-39574 (8,390.25): paid today by same-day wire PAY-2026-04354, released to bank. The invoice had been blocked for a price variance until it was released at 10:30 today.

#6 VT-23912 (8,910.25): PAY-2026-04350 failed. The bank rejected that file on 3/31 (RJCT, invalid file format, no payment executed), so the invoice was still open. I re-sent it as same-day wire PAY-2026-04355, released. #7 SC-93643 (38,230.25): already in payment run F110-0331-A, which executes today at 18:00. Not paid by a second route.
#8 CP-1181 (4,540.00, company 1000): was parked with approval complete (T.Becker, 3/31). Posted today as 5100003402, so it is now in AP and included in next week's payment run.

#10 TF-61509 (35,300.50): already paid. PAY-2026-04352 settled on 3/30 in run F110-0330-A and shows on the bank statement the same day. Please tell Tidewater Freight it was paid on 3/30. No new payment was made.
